artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in buff, light brown, light violet gray, and dark gray
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered near a riverside landscape. The image shows individuals dressed in flowing garments around an infant on a small stone altar. Some figures gesture towards the baby, while others look on. The background features a cityscape, a bridge, and a large, leafy tree dominating the right side. The drawing is in monochromatic sepia tones, giving it an antique appearance. The detailing in the clothing and the organic forms of the trees contrast with the structured city in the background.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [left plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people beneath an architectural structure with arches. It features several individuals in period clothing standing under the arches. Some figures appear engaged in an exchange, while others are arranged in a line. In the background, there are cliffs and sparse vegetation. The style resembles traditional etching or lithography techniques.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [center plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people standing on the steps of a classical building. The scene shows figures gathered on a set of stairs leading to a large architectural structure with ornate features, such as columns with elaborate capitals. The building has multiple levels with balconies where additional figures are observing the scene below. In the foreground, an assortment of individuals are arranged with expressions of engagement and interaction. Detailed lines are used to convey folds in clothing and the texture of architectural elements. The background includes a partial landscape with hints of trees. The drawing is rendered in a highly detailed and classical style reminiscent of Renaissance or early Baroque works.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [right plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This drawing features classical architecture and figures on stairs. The scene shows various figures descending a staircase adorned with columns. One figure stands at the top with raised hands, while another in elaborate drapery is among them. At the base of the stairs is a basket of goods, and beneath the staircase is a heraldic emblem with the inscription 'DUCTI AMOR PATRIAE'. The figures and architectural details are depicted in fine line work, resembling engraving or etching.

artworks.title: The Virgin in Clouds and Six Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of line block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of religious figures in a celestial setting. The illustration shows a composition divided into two main sections. In the upper section, there is a depiction of a holy scene with a central figure holding a child, surrounded by cherubs, all set amidst an array of clouds. Above them, an eagle is featured, emanating rays of light. In the lower section, several figures in ornate robes and religious attire are gathered, one holding a book and another a large staff. The style is characterized by intricate detailing and classical motifs often associated with religious iconography, with the artist rendering figures and drapery with precision and depth. The effect is that of a divine assembly mirroring traditional religious tableaux.

artworks.title: The Death of Saint Peter Martyr
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof]
artworks.description: This drawing depicts multiple figures in a forest setting. An angelic figure hovers at the top with wings outstretched. The forest below is filled with intricately detailed trees. Figures on the ground are in dynamic poses, one showing surprise or fear, and another reaching upwards. The composition is detailed with flowing garments and textured foliage, evoking tension and animation.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple (The Circumcision)
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people assembled under an ornate, classical-style archway. The scene features figures dressed in flowing robes, gathered in a space defined by an architectural structure that includes columns and a large decorative arch adorned with rich patterns and sculptural elements. Above the group, an archway displays intricate detailing, including patterns and depictions of figures who appear to be gesticulating or interacting symbolically with the scene below. The texture of the robes and other elements is conveyed using fine lines and cross-hatching, suggesting a detailed and expressive style, depicting a dramatic or religious narrative.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a natural setting under a canopy of large trees. The individuals are standing or sitting, interacting with each other. The central figure is seated on a slightly elevated surface, wearing elaborate clothing and jewelry. Other people around them are dressed in flowing garments, possibly tunics or robes, engaged in various activities. One figure is leaning forward with a baby in a basket, while others observe. The background shows a natural setting with an architectural structure on the left side. The illustration is monochrome with intricate shading and details.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a central figure surrounded by angelic figures. The main figure is sitting in the center, with other figures around them, some of whom have wings. They are interacting with a newborn in a tender atmosphere. Above, there are cherubs or angelic faces with wings surrounding the scene, and one figure flying downwards towards the characters below. The drawing is detailed, with attention to drapery, posture, and expression, conveying a sense of divine celebration or religious significance.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with angels and celestial figures. The image shows a gathering of ethereal beings surrounding a central figure holding an infant. The background is filled with winged cherubs and clouds, implying a heavenly setting. To the left, figures are playing musical instruments. The composition is rich with intricate patterns and flowing drapery.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in browns [trial proof?]
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures surrounding a central seated figure holding a child. The central figure is dressed in draped fabric and is surrounded by figures, some with wings. She has gentle facial features and her head is covered with a veil. The child in her lap is nude. Surrounding her are angels and another figure, possibly a queen, elegantly clothed in a richly patterned dress and crown, with an offering gesture towards the child. The angels are engaged in musical activities. The figures have classical expressions, with curly hair. The background depicts clouds and cherubic figures with wings. There are architectural elements, such as a fluted column with an ornate capital and a large piece of drapery hanging from it.

artworks.title: Holy Family and Four Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in black [trial proof of key block] on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed woodcut depicting a religious scene with several figures. A woman sits on a throne-like chair, holding a child in her lap. An adult kneels before them at an altar, with a book-like object on the base. Another robed man stands to the side holding a staff. Two additional figures are visible, a child standing on the altar and another figure peering from behind the throne with a staff. The background is adorned with ornate patterns, and an architectural arch frames the scene.

artworks.title: Holy Family and Four Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in brown and gray [trial proof] on laid paper
artworks.description: The illustration features several figures in full body view, with a woman holding a child in the center. The child interacts with a cross held by a man kneeling in front. Another man on the right looks towards the child, while a figure kneels with a cross in hand. On the left, a figure with wing-like elements stands with slight forward lean. The setting is ornately decorated with wall patterns, columns, and floral motifs. The background is detailed with various patterns.

artworks.title: Holy Family and Four Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in brown and gray [trial proof] on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts six figures in a detailed illustration. In the center, a woman sits on a throne holding a child. Surrounding them are three more individuals. To the left, a woman stands with a side profile, and a man in a robe is kneeling next to them. To the right, there is an older man with a long beard, halfway seen. Each person wears robes with intricate drapery and some hold religious or symbolic objects. The background features a richly patterned tapestry or mural.

artworks.title: Holy Family and Four Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in brown [trial proof] on laid paper

artworks.title: The Marriage at Cana [left plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a festive gathering in a classical architectural setting. The scene depicts a detailed gathering of figures in lavish attire within a grand architectural space filled with columns, arches, and decorative elements. The drawing features intricate line work, creating patterns and textures. The setting includes large Corinthian columns and a balcony with balustrades. In the lower section, there is a grand banquet with figures in elaborate costumes seated around a table with dishes. Various characters are engaged in conversations, and musicians appear to be entertaining. The upper section shows more figures looking over the balcony at the gathering below. The architectural elements suggest classical and Renaissance influences, framed by bold lines highlighting the opulent decoration and interactions within.

artworks.title: The Marriage at Cana [right plate]
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]

artworks.title: The Crucifixion [left plate]
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with horses, knights, and laborers. The composition is crowded with figures engaged in various actions. At the forefront, several knights are mounted on horses, dressed in armor or detailed garments. These figures are depicted with a high level of detail and contrast. Behind them, other figures appear to be laborers, engaging in physical work with tools and building materials scattered on the ground. The background includes a landscape with a castle or fortress atop a hill surrounded by trees. The style emphasizes strong lines and contrasts, typical of detailed woodcut or engraving techniques, giving the scene an intricate quality.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion [center plate]
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central wooden cross with a male figure affixed upon it, above which is a sign reading "I.N.R.I." Surrounding this central figure are various individuals in different postures. Some are standing or kneeling, looking upwards towards the cross, while others appear to be engaged in discussions or movements. The scene is rendered in a dramatic black-and-white style, with strong contrasts creating an emotive atmosphere. The sky behind the cross is depicted with bold, swirling cloud formations, enhancing the intense mood of the image. The detailed depiction of garments and facial expressions suggests a deep narrative complexity.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion [right plate]
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers and horses. The scene includes mounted soldiers wielding weapons such as lances and swords, amidst fallen figures. The foreground features a horse's back with a floral motif. In the mid-ground, several figures are in motion. The background includes trees, contributing to the chaotic setting. The composition is detailed, with strong contrasts between dark and light areas, using line work to convey texture and depth in the landscape, attire, and musculature of the horses.

artworks.title: The Entombment [recto]
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a print of people in a wooded landscape. In the center, a mostly nude man lies in a cloth, his head tilted backwards. The cloth is held at each end by two other people who appear to be using it to lower the man to the ground. This central group is surrounded by other people who sit or crouch on the ground. Detailed trees form a canopy overhead, with strong shadows and light creating depth. In the background, a cityscape can be seen with buildings and a hill that has several crosses on top of it.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in browns [trial proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with several individuals gathered around a central figure draped in cloth. In the background, there is a cityscape under a cloudy sky above the trees. The artwork is detailed with emphasis on line and form, using a sepia color palette. Trees frame the sides, with torches held by some figures adding vertical light elements.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel descending from the sky towards people in a natural landscape. The figures are reclined among rocks and foliage. In the background is a cityscape with towers and a fortified wall. Below the scene is an inscription in a classical font. The image is monochromatic in brown tones with emphasis on linear contrasts and texture.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Leandro Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black [trial proof of key block]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered around a central event. The figures are dressed in robes and are under an arched structure amidst trees and foliage. The scene appears to depict a moment of urgency or significance, with figures leaning in toward the center. The detailed rendering of the trees and architectural elements suggests a setting that is both outdoor and influenced by classical themes. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer, emphasizing a strong use of contrast and line work.
